# Interactive exposure session: ad-heavy sites likely to run programmatic ads through the
# exchanges named in the AdFection reports (Google Authorized Buyers, Yandex, Eskimi,
# Beeswax/FreeWheel, Xandr). These are ordinary publishers, not threat infrastructure.
# Exposure is probabilistic and per-device; visiting them proves nothing by itself.
